mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, code, approve_status, type, data_json, remark
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, '1' AS releaseType, m.type AS messageType, m.application AS application, m.notice_title AS noticeTitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.data_json, ''), m.remark, '') AS content, m.notice_time AS noticeTime, m.expire_time AS expireTime FROM message m LEFT JOIN message_user_read mur ON m.id = mur.message_id AND mur.is_deleted = FALSE AND mur.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.is_deleted = FALSE AND COALESCE(mur.is_read, FALSE) = FALSE AND m.type = 'sys' AND m.application IN ('PDA', 'PC') AND (m.notice_time IS NULL OR m.notice_time <= NOW()) AND (m.expire_time IS NULL OR m.expire_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY COALESCE(m.notice_time, m.create_time) DESC, m.create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, '1' AS releaseType, m.type AS messageType, m.application AS application, m.notice_title AS noticeTitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.data_json, ''), m.remark, '') AS content, m.notice_time AS noticeTime, m.expire_time AS expireTime FROM message m LEFT JOIN message_user_read mur ON m.id = mur.message_id AND mur.is_deleted = FALSE AND mur.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.is_deleted = FALSE AND COALESCE(mur.is_read, FALSE) = FALSE AND m.type = 'sys' AND m.application = #{application} AND (m.notice_time IS NULL OR m.notice_time <= NOW()) AND (m.expire_time IS NULL OR m.expire_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY COALESCE(m.notice_time, m.create_time) DESC, m.create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.upgrade_version as upgradeVersion, m.data_json, m.create_time as noticeTime FROM message m LEFT JOIN message_user_read mur ON mur.message_id = m.id WHERE m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.application = 'sysVersion' AND (m.expire_time IS NULL OR m.expire_time >= NOW()) AND mur.user_id = #{userId} AND mur.is_read = FALSE AND mur.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
